statement: Add an OpenRouter chat-completions client in beep-boop. It POSTs to the configured OpenRouter chat URL with the bearer key from the environment, returns the same text/usage/metadata shape the unified LLM client already uses, and redacts the key from errors. When UnifiedLLMClient cloud_provider is openrouter, Ollama failure uses that client. Default cloud_provider stays openai.

expected_io.returns: OpenRouterConfigError; message does not contain the key
OpenRouterHTTPError status_code=401; message does not contain sk-test
text from the injected OpenRouter client
